description: Returns a page where the user buys WozApi credits for single lookups and pays with iDEAL. This tool moves no money. Works when the user is signed in to WozApi, with the connected API key, or with a trial_code that has the user's e-mail address.

credits.description: Optional. Number of credits; leave empty for the suggested amount.

trial_code.description: The trial_code from start_trial. Leave empty when the user is signed in to WozApi or the connection has a WozApi API key.

name: create_credit_payment_link
title: Betaallink voor credits
